description:
USAN is seeking an enthusiastic Application Developer to join our Amazon Connect solutions team. As a team member, you would be primarily responsible for the design, discovery, configuration/integration, and implementation of solutions aimed at the contact center space. 

 


 You will work on a small team in a highly collaborative way to create effective and innovative call center solutions for enterprise clients. You will also be contributing towards integrations between the Amazon Connect solution and a myriad of 3rd party solution partners, including USAN-proprietary systems/products. 

 


 ***Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.  No agencies please. 

 
 


 Duties: 

 
 Translate customer requirements into technical requirements

 Collaborate internally in the SDLC with USAN project managers, business analysts, technical consultants, and Operations counterparts

 Develop, test, and maintain solutions for Amazon Connect and related services

 Perform problem resolution for existing solutions

 Make informed design and configuration decisions

 Stay current on upcoming Amazon Connect enhancements, features, and latest contact center trends
 

 
 Basic Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science

 2+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud and/or premise-based ACD-Automatic Call Distribution / Contact Center solutions

 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

 General knowledge of professional software development practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle

 Team-oriented and self-motivated

 The ability to communicate ideas effectively, to listen to others’ ideas, and to collaborate to arrive at great solutions

 Experience with Visual Studio, VSCode, or similar IDEs.

 Exposure to C#, ASP.Net, Python, NodeJS, SQL, SQL Server, and/or Perl a plus

 2+ years experience with React

 2+ years experience in web application development

 Hybrid role - must be in HQ - Norcross, GA Tuesdays and Thursdays
 

 
 


 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 3+ years of experience in Amazon Connect (contact flows, console feature provisioning, configuration management, reporting, etc.)

 3+ years experience with React

 3+ years experience with AWS services

 3+ years experience in web application development

 Experience in viewing/understanding Amazon Connect CTRs

 Experience in Amazon QuickSight, Contact Lens, Q in Connect, etc.

 General working knowledge of SQL database concepts

 Demonstrated ability to take a project or significant feature from concept to launch
 


 
 Job Benefits: 

 
 Competitive compensation program

 Outstanding benefits package (including medical, dental, vision and life insurance)

 401(k) plan

 Excellent holiday/vacation plans

 Employee Referral Bonus Program

 Annual performance-based bonus

 Ongoing training opportunities

 
 


 Company Description 


 United States Advanced Network, In. (USAN) is a privately held corporation based out of Norcross, GA (a suburb of Atlanta, GA).  USAN is an AWS Advanced Tier Partner specializing in Amazon Connect, helping organizations design and deploy scalable, AI-driven customer interactions that accelerate time to value and maximize ROI. With over 35 years of deep contact center expertise, USAN delivers modern agentic CX solutions and a white-glove approach to optimizing and managing cloud contact center environments through its managed services.    


   


 For more information, please visit us at   www.usan.com
